name: es30-immutable-storage
title: Immutable texture storage and sized formats
summary: glTexStorage2D / glTexStorage3D allocate every level at once: TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_FORMAT / TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_LEVELS, mip ladders and textureSize of all levels, the level-count limit (which dimensions count), respecification errors that change nothing (the contact sheet drawn again is byte-identical), BASE_LEVEL clamping; plus 13 sized internal formats uploaded with their valid format/type pairs and compared with CPU-decoded values, and 30 valid/invalid format/type/internalformat combinations.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.4 Immutable-Format Texture Images (TexStorage2D/3D, level count rule, errors, respecification errors, TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_FORMAT/LEVELS)
ES 3.0 §3.7.2 Transfer of Pixel Rectangles (Tables 3.2 and 3.3: valid combinations of format, type and internal format; 3.7.2.2 packed types)

ES 3.0 §3.8.3 Texture Image Specification (Table 3.13 sized internal formats, 3.8.3.1 required formats, 3.8.3.2 RGB9_E5 encoding, depth formats only for 2D/array/cube; ES 3.2 §8.5 for the INVALID_ENUM / INVALID_VALUE rules)
ES 3.0 §3.8.5 Alternate Texture Image Specification Commands (TexSubImage, CopyTexSubImage; the same format constraints apply)
ES 3.0 §3.8.10 (equations 3.14 and 3.15: BASE_LEVEL / MAX_LEVEL clamping for immutable textures; 3.8.10.4 mipmaps), §3.8.13 Texture Completeness, §3.9.2 (incomplete textures sample (0,0,0,1))
ES 3.0 §2.1.3 - §2.1.6 (half float, 11-bit and 10-bit float, conversion between float and normalized fixed point: equations 2.1 - 2.4), §6.1.3 (GetTexParameter TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_*)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers, §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions (texture, textureLod, textureSize)

api.glTexStorage2D: 13 sized formats x 23 upload cases, a 4-level 8x8 ladder, 7x5 and cube map textures: IMMUTABLE_FORMAT/LEVELS queried, every level sampled; accepted at floor(log2(max(w,h)))+1 levels and INVALID_OPERATION above it (non-square, cube), INVALID_VALUE for levels/width/height <= 0, INVALID_ENUM for TEXTURE_3D/TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY targets, INVALID_OPERATION for the default texture and for a repeated call (also with identical parameters)
api.glTexStorage3D: immutable 4x2x8 3D texture (4 levels) and 6x3x5 array texture (3 levels): textureSize of every level; level limit counts the depth of a 3D texture but not the layers of an array; INVALID_VALUE for depth/levels 0; INVALID_ENUM for TEXTURE_2D / TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP; DEPTH_COMPONENT16 -> INVALID_OPERATION for TEXTURE_3D and accepted for the array
api.glTexSubImage2D: the only way texels reach the immutable textures: every valid (format, type) pair of Table 3.2 for 13 sized formats, compared with CPU-decoded values; a sub-rectangle at a nonzero offset of level 1; mismatching pairs on RGBA8 and RGB565 levels -> INVALID_OPERATION; cube map faces/levels
api.glTexSubImage3D: layer 4 of an immutable 6-layer array texture written and read back
api.glTexImage2D: 30 (internalformat, format, type) combinations: valid pairs accepted, invalid pairs INVALID_OPERATION (Mesa XFAIL for unsized RGB + FLOAT); as the refused respecification of immutable textures (own parameters and others); mutable contrast textures
api.glTexImage3D: refused on immutable 3D and array textures (INVALID_OPERATION); DEPTH_COMPONENT16 with TEXTURE_3D -> INVALID_OPERATION, with TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY accepted
api.glCopyTexSubImage2D: allowed on an immutable texture: the framebuffer color (204,51,102,255) is read back from the texture
api.glGetTexParameteriv: TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_FORMAT and TEXTURE_IMMUTABLE_LEVELS for 2D, 3D, array and cube map textures (TRUE and the level count; FALSE and 0 for a texture made by glTexImage2D); WRAP_S round trip
api.glTexParameteri: MIN/MAG filter and BASE_LEVEL of every panel on immutable textures (observed through the sampled colors; BASE_LEVEL = 100 is clamped), WRAP_S
api.glGenTextures: format, ladder, size and scratch textures
api.glBindTexture: TEXTURE_2D on unit 0, TEXTURE_3D on unit 1, TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY on unit 2 per panel
api.glBindFramebuffer: readback of texture levels and layers
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: reads back texels of an immutable 2D texture, cube map faces and levels (framebuffer complete, texels equal)
api.glFramebufferTextureLayer: reads back layer 4 of an immutable array texture
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: COMPLETE for every face and level of an immutable cube map, including unwritten ones
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the whole sheet and of texture images
api.glViewport: per-panel viewport maps the quad to the panel
api.glClearColor: sheet background and the framebuffer color copied by glCopyTexSubImage2D
api.glGetUniformLocation: sampler, mode, lod, scale and bias uniforms located
api.glUniform1i: sampler uniforms hold texture UNIT indices (0, 1, 2); u_mode and u_lod select texture / textureLod / textureSize
api.glUniform4f: u_scale and u_bias bring snorm and half-float values into the 8-bit range

visual_review.notes: Window-filling layout reviewed on llvmpipe captures at 640x400 (8x5 grid) and 800x800 (5x8 grid) and the 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture (5x8). All 40 panels fill the window, no empty cells. The format panels show their 4x4 texels as equal blocks; the mip ladder shows red, green with the magenta box, blue, yellow; the incomplete mutable panels are black; the base-level panels yellow and black; the textureSize panels are flat colors encoding the sizes.
